name: Relic of the Thief
description: Upon striking an enemy with an eligible weapon skill, gain a stacking outgoing strike-damage increase; triggering again refreshes all stacks.

uptime_model.trigger: Hit an enemy with a weapon skill that has a recharge or resource cost

notes: One stack per eligible trigger, up to five stacks.
Each stack is +1% outgoing strike damage.
Stacks last 6 seconds and all stacks refresh on a new trigger.
Not applied until the rotation engine supplies real eligible-hit timestamps.
